items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Second wife, '61? I must be married to the first wife. The second one, I was way down the road. I done broke off with Nazarro when I got the second wife.

ctx.x: Your second wife -- your third wife?
Second wife, '61? I must be married to the first wife. The second one, I was way down the road. I done broke off with Nazarro when I got the second wife.
